abilities.name: Starfrost Swirl
abilities.caveat: Soulwind isn't shown — party members gain 22% ATK SPD for 12s while they're on the field.
_curatorNotes: Generator authored 'behavior: "stance"'; changed to 'instant'. Soulwind is a 12s team ATK SPD buff — normals/charge are not replaced. Reviewer to decide if buff duration needs self-status representation.

Soulwind team ATK SPD buff not authorable (capability sweep 2026-07-28): gcsim skill.go:220-227 skillBuff() adds an AtkSpd StatMod to every party member for 12s; mika_gen.go:188 atkSpdBuff[9]=0.22 (TL10 = 22%). The Stat union has no attack-speed key (vocabulary frozen pre-launch), so the mechanic is caveated instead of authored.

Hold variant has cooldownStartDelay=12 (skillHoldCDStart=11 + 1 delay) which cannot be represented on AbilityVariant in current schema. Base cooldownStartDelay=16 applies to Tap only — Hold delay is distinct.
abilities.description:
Mika uses his crossbow to attack, granting all nearby characters in your party Soulwind. When characters in the Soulwind state are on the field, their ATK SPD will be increased.
Will take effect in different ways if Tapped or Held.

Tap
Fires a Flowfrost Arrow that can pierce through opponents, dealing Cryo DMG to enemies it comes into contact with.

Hold
Goes into Aiming Mode, locking on to an opponent and firing a Rimestar Flare at them, dealing Cryo DMG. When the Rimestar Flare hits, it will rise before exploding, launching Rimestar Shards into a maximum of 3 other opponents, dealing Cryo DMG.

abilities.name: Skyfeather Song
_curatorNotes: Generator authored 'behavior: "stance"'; changed to 'instant'. Eagleplume is a 15s heal-on-normal-hit team buff — normals/charge are not replaced. Reviewer to decide if buff duration needs self-status representation.

Both heals authored 2026-07-12 at talent level 10. gcsim burst.go Burst(): initial heal = burstHealFirstF[9] + burstHealFirstP[9]*MaxHP, Heal Target -1 (all party) → target 'team'; sidecar 'Cast Healing' col 10 = '21.9% Max HP+2579' (burstHealFirstP[9]=0.219024, burstHealFirstF[9]=2578.6736). Authored as onCast(burst) heal, scaling 21.9% HP + flat 2579.

Eagleplume on-hit heal (gcsim onBurstHeal, subscribes OnEnemyDamage): fires when the ACTIVE character's Normal Attack (AttackTagNormal) hits while healKey 'eagleplume' is active; heals active.Index() → target 'active'. Per-active-character ICD healIcd = 2.5*60 frames → procCooldown 2.5. Authored trigger onHit + abilityType 'normal' + source 'team' (only the active char can Normal-attack; mirrors thoma burst onHit source='team'). TL10 = burstHealF[9]=514.73846 + burstHealP[9]=0.043776*MaxHP; sidecar 'Eagleplume Healing' col 10 = '4.4% Max HP+515' → scaling 4.4% HP + flat 515.

Trigger-live window: the Eagleplume on-hit heal is only active for 15s after cast (gcsim c.AddStatus(healKey, 15*60); sidecar 'Eagleplume Duration' 15.0s). No summons[] authored — Eagleplume is a team status, not a spatial entity; the 15s window is not rendered as a bar, matching the thoma/traveler_electro precedent that burst-hosted onHit effects scope to the burst window. procCooldown captures the 2.5s cadence only.

Both heals apply Mika's Healing Bonus at cast (gcsim Bonus: c.Stat(attributes.Heal)) — standard, not separately modelled. C1 Factor Confluence reduces the Eagleplume interval by the Soulwind ATK SPD% (gcsim Init: healIcd *= 1 - atkSpdBuff); base C0 interval 2.5s authored, C1 interaction noted on the C1 node. C4 Sunfrost Encomium energy return on each Eagleplume heal noted on the C4 node — not authored here.

[A7] The instant party heal (onCast burst, target 'team') is authored at talent-10 values and reaches the Team Builder's heal capability facet; it was dropped from the caveat text as 'working behavior', and the caveat now focuses on the conditional Eagleplume on-hit heal (onHit normal, source 'team', procCooldown 2.5, target 'active').

⚠️ 2026-08-18: the [A7] note's 'shown at cast' was WRONG when written and is still wrong — a `heal` Effect reaches NO planner surface. Nothing in `src/lib/timeline/` or `buffWindows.ts` reads `type: 'heal'` (grep); the ONLY heal a planner reader ever sees is a `summonTick` heal, and even then it is seen as a generic tick MARK on the summon lane — `finalize` accepts every summonTick effect with `() => true` and the mark says the tick happened, not that it healed. This burst authors no `summons[]` (deliberately — Eagleplume is a team status, not a spatial entity, per the note above), so neither the instant party heal nor the Eagleplume heal draws anything at all. The data is correct; 'working behavior' was the wrong test — presence in the JSON and a Team Builder facet are not a planner surface. ⛔ Don't take this as a reason to rewrite the caveat: it was re-audited 2026-08-18 and stands as written. This note exists so the next curator does not repeat the who-renders mistake.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — Healing has no planner surface for ANY character — the burst's instant team heal and the Eagleplume onHit heal are both authored and both draw nothing (the entry's own 2026-08-18 note establishes this). Unlike the Soulwind caveat above, no reader looks for a heal bar, because no character has ever had one; the absence is uniform, not a Mika divergence. ⚠ Overrides the entry's "stands as written" note, which was written under the accuracy test, not the pixel test. Category: invisible-omission.
abilities.description:
Derives the ability to spur his teammates on from the recited prayers of the knightly order, regenerating HP for all nearby party members. This healing is based on Mika's Max HP and will grant them the Eagleplume state.

Eagleplume
When the Normal Attacks of active characters affected by Eagleplume hit an opponent, Mika will help them regenerate HP based on his Max HP.
Characters affected by this state can only regenerate HP in this way once per short interval of time.

passives.name: Suppressive Barrage
_curatorNotes: Detector stack system not authored. Physical DMG +10% per stack for active characters in Soulwind (max 3 stacks = +30%; max 4 with A4 unlocked). Stack gain: Flowfrost Arrow hitting >1 enemy grants 1 per extra hit; each Rimestar Shard hit grants 1 stack. All stacks cleared on Soulwind recast.

Doubly unmodelable (capability sweep 2026-07-28): the Stat union has no physical-DMG-bonus key (only physicalRes), and stack gain counts per-additional-enemy hits, which the per-swing single-hit model cannot count (gcsim skill.go:71-86 a1CB/addDetectorStack). Caveated instead of authored.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — The Physical DMG buff bar that isn't there. The passive authors no effects, and there is no `physicalDmgBonus` key in the stat vocabulary at all — so a DMG-bonus bar, the thing a reader expects from a stated DMG% buff, can never appear. The cap ladder (A4/C6) and the multi-target earn condition are kit explanation on top of an already-empty lane. Category: expected-but-absent.
passives.description:
Per the following circumstances, the Soulwind state caused by Starfrost Swirl will grant characters the Detector effect, increasing their Physical DMG by 10% when they are on the field.
·If the Flowfrost Arrow hits more than one opponent, each additional opponent hit will generate 1 Detector stack.
·When a Rimestar Shard hits an opponent, it will generate 1 Detector stack. Each Rimestar Shard can trigger the effect 1 time.

The Soulwind state can have a maximum of 3 Detector stacks, and if Starfrost Swirl is cast again during this duration, the pre-existing Soulwind state and all its Detector stacks will be cleared.

passives.name: Topographical Mapping
_curatorNotes: A4 mechanic not authored. On CRIT hit while active character has both Soulwind and Eagleplume active simultaneously, grants 1 Detector stack (once per Soulwind instance). Also increases max Detector stacks by 1. gcsim: subscribes to OnEnemyDamage, checks StatModIsActive(soulwind) && StatusIsActive(eagleplume) && crit. Needs reviewer pass.
passives.description:
When an active character affected by both Skyfeather Song's Eagleplume and Starfrost Swirl's Soulwind at once scores a CRIT Hit with their attacks, Soulwind will grant them 1 stack of Detector from the Ascension Talent Suppressive Barrage. During a single instance of Soulwind, 1 Detector stack can be gained in this manner.
Additionally, the maximum number of stacks that can be gained through Soulwind alone is increased by 1.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Suppressive Barrage."
